mentions.name: Catchcam
mentions.description: This is a privacy-first, offline speed camera detector for drivers that plugs into a car's USB socket. It features a built-in speaker and LED for alerts, comes preloaded with 66,000+ known speed camera locations, and supports updates via drag-and-drop on a PC, all without tracking the user's location or requiring an internet connection.
mentions.problem: Existing speed camera apps like Waze or Radarbot track your location and require an internet connection.
mentions.audience: Drivers who want alerts about speed cameras without being tracked or needing an internet connection.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Catchcam - https://hackaday.io/project/199220-catchcam-speed-camera-detector, a privacy-first, offline speed camera detector for drivers. Unlike apps like Waze or Radarbot, Catchcam doesn’t track your location or require an internet connection. Just plug it into your USB socket, and you’re good to go.
